svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Atlas in the middle of a region. Central and Cargo call the Atlas tenant API. Atlas calls Metal on every host over mutual TLS for VM changes and a host sync every 10 seconds. Atlas orders hosts from server providers, writes DNS records and certificates, keeps image artifacts in object storage, and installs and configures service VMs over SSH. Atlas and Metal push metrics to Datum.

text.tspan: VM changes · host sync every 10 s
